why: Второе условное говорит о нереальных или маловероятных ситуациях в настоящем и будущем: «если бы я был богат, я бы купил остров». В русском для этого есть «бы», а в английском сигнал — глагол в прошедшем времени после if, хотя речь НЕ о прошлом.
formation: If I had more time, I would learn Spanish.
• Отрицание: If I didn't have to work, I would travel more. / I wouldn't say that if I were you.
• Вопрос: What would you do if you won a million dollars?
• Глагол to be: после if для всех лиц обычно используют were: If I were you, I would accept the offer. (В разговорной речи допустимо и was: If he was here...)
• would можно заменить на could (= мог бы) или might (= возможно, смог бы): If I had a car, I could drive to work.
• Сокращение: would = 'd (I'd go), would not = wouldn't.
usage: If I were a manager, I would change the process. (Если бы я был менеджером, я бы изменил процесс. — но я не менеджер.)
If I won the lottery, I would quit my job. (Если бы я выиграл в лотерею, я бы уволился.)
3. Совет в формуле If I were you.
If I were you, I would talk to your boss. (На твоём месте я бы поговорил с начальником.)
What would you do if you could fly? (Что бы ты делал, если бы мог летать?)
signalWords: If I were you, imagine, suppose, what if, «если бы», «на твоём месте».
Разница с первым условным: If I have time, I will help (реально, вполне возможно) и If I had time, I would help (но времени нет или вряд ли будет).
mistakes: ✗ If I would have money, I would buy a car. → ✓ If I had money, I would buy a car. (would нельзя ставить после if)
✗ If I will be rich, I would travel. → ✓ If I were rich, I would travel. (будущее после if не ставим)
✗ If I was you, I will go. → ✓ If I were you, I would go. (в главной части — would, не will)
✗ If I would be you → ✓ If I were you (после if нужен Past Simple или were)
✗ I would go if I have time. → ✓ I would go if I had time. (части должны согласоваться по типу условия)
remember: If + прошедшее, would + глагол: прошедшее время здесь «отодвигает» ситуацию от реальности, а не от настоящего.

exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в нужную форму (Past Simple или would + глагол)

items.prompt: If I ___ (have) more money, I would buy a new laptop.
items.answer: had

items.prompt: If she knew the answer, she ___ (tell) us.
items.answer: would tell

items.prompt: We ___ (travel) around the world if we had more free time.
items.answer: would travel

items.prompt: If I ___ (be) you, I would apply for that job.
items.answer: were

items.prompt: If they lived closer, they ___ (visit) us more often.
items.answer: would visit

items.prompt: He would be healthier if he ___ (not eat) so much fast food.
items.answer: didn't eat / did not eat

items.prompt: If you ___ (speak) better English, you would find a job abroad.
items.answer: spoke

items.prompt: I ___ (not buy) that car if I were you.
items.answer: wouldn't buy / would not buy

items.prompt: If I (a) have (b) had a bigger apartment, I would invite all my friends.
items.answer: (b) had

items.prompt: If she (a) would know (b) knew his number, she would call him.
items.answer: (b) knew

items.prompt: What (a) will (b) would you do if you lost your job?
items.answer: (b) would

items.prompt: If I (a) was (b) were you, I would talk to the teacher.
items.answer: (b) were (was is also possible in informal speech)

items.prompt: We (a) would go (b) will go to the beach if the weather were better.
items.answer: (a) would go

items.prompt: If he (a) didn't work (b) wouldn't work so much, he would have more free time.
items.answer: (a) didn't work

items.prompt: I (a) could (b) can help you if I knew how to do it.
items.answer: (a) could

items.prompt: If it (a) is (b) were Saturday today, we would be at the park.
items.answer: (b) were

items.prompt: I don't have a car, so I don't drive to work. -> If I ___, I ___ to work.
items.answer: had a car, I would drive

items.prompt: She isn't rich, so she doesn't travel a lot. -> If she ___ rich, she ___ a lot.
items.answer: were / was rich, she would travel

items.prompt: He doesn't know Spanish, so he can't work in Madrid. -> If he ___ Spanish, he ___ in Madrid.
items.answer: knew Spanish, he could work

items.prompt: We live far from the office, so we are always late. -> If we ___ closer, we ___ always late.
items.answer: lived closer, we wouldn't be / would not be

items.prompt: Make a question: What / you / do / if / you / win / a lottery?
items.answer: What would you do if you won the lottery? / What would you do if you won a lottery?

items.prompt: Give advice using If I were you: You should talk to your manager.
items.answer: If I were you, I would talk to your manager. / If I were you, I'd talk to your manager.

items.prompt: Make negative: If I had time, I would help you.
items.answer: If I didn't have time, I wouldn't help you.

items.prompt: Rewrite with the if-part second: If I were a doctor, I would help people.
items.answer: I would help people if I were a doctor.

items.prompt: If I would have more time, I would learn to play the guitar.
items.answer: If I had more time, I would learn to play the guitar.

items.prompt: If I will be you, I would not do that.
items.answer: If I were you, I would not do that.

items.prompt: If she had a car, she will drive to work.
items.answer: If she had a car, she would drive to work.

items.prompt: What you would do if you were president?
items.answer: What would you do if you were president?

items.prompt: I would buy a house if I have a lot of money.
items.answer: I would buy a house if I had a lot of money.

items.prompt: If he didn't be so busy, he would come to the party.
items.answer: If he weren't so busy, he would come to the party. / If he wasn't so busy, he would come to the party.

items.prompt: If they would live in Kyiv, they would see us often.
items.answer: If they lived in Kyiv, they would see us often.

items.prompt: She would be happier if she not worked so much.
items.answer: She would be happier if she didn't work so much.

items.prompt: Если бы у меня было больше времени, я бы выучил французский.
items.answer: If I had more time, I would learn French.

items.prompt: На твоём месте я бы поговорил с начальником.
items.answer: If I were you, I would talk to my boss. / If I were you, I would talk to your boss. / If I were you, I would talk to the boss.

items.prompt: Что бы ты делал, если бы выиграл миллион долларов?
items.answer: What would you do if you won a million dollars?

items.prompt: Если бы я не работал в IT, я бы, наверное, был учителем.
items.answer: If I didn't work in IT, I would probably be a teacher.

items.prompt: Мы бы поехали в отпуск, если бы у нас были деньги.
items.answer: We would go on vacation if we had money. / We would go on vacation if we had the money.

items.prompt: Если бы он знал правду, он бы расстроился.
items.answer: If he knew the truth, he would be upset.

items.prompt: Я бы не сказал этого, если бы был на твоём месте.
items.answer: I wouldn't say that if I were you. / I wouldn't say that if I were in your place.

items.prompt: Если бы сервер работал быстрее, пользователи были бы счастливее.
items.answer: If the server worked faster, the users would be happier. / If the server were faster, the users would be happier.
